properties.site-address: Former Gardman Premises, High Street, Moulton

properties.notes: The South East Lincolnshire Strategic Housing Land Availability Assessment (SHLAA) (April 2017) indicates that there is a Grade 1 listed windmill to the north of the site and it is adjacent to the Moulton Conservation Area. Any development proposal would need to be informed by a Heritage Impact Assessment. In addition, the land is filled in places and is a former factory and so there may be some contamination. SHLAA ref no: Mou035. http://www.southeastlincslocalplan.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Moulton-map-and-report.pdf
